{{Top|leg}}
'''ROM''' was part of an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid's]] hardware. Its ROM library stored design plans and schematics of over seven hundred designs to allow the astromech to interface effectively.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
